extraction_notes: Fig. 1 provides a usable SD103AWS-SD103CWS typical forward-characteristic curve at Ta = 25 degC. The six points are direct observations at plotted vertical grid lines from the supplied vector plot; no intermediate points were synthesized.

Fig. 2 provides usable typical reverse-characteristic curves at Ta = 25 degC and Ta = 100 degC. The seven points on each curve are direct observations at plotted voltage grid lines, with reverse current represented as a positive magnitude on the plotted microampere axis; no intermediate points were synthesized.

The electrical-characteristics table gives maximum VF1 = 0.37 V at IF = 20 mA and maximum VF2 = 0.60 V at IF = 200 mA, both at Ta = 25 degC. It gives maximum IR = 5.0 microampere for SD103AWS at VR = 30 V and Ta = 25 degC, and typical CJ = 50 pF at VR = 0 V and f = 1 MHz.

Absolute maximum bounds for SD103AWS are VRRM = 40 V, VRMS = 28 V, VDC = 40 V, IF(AV) = 0.35 A, and IFSM = 1.5 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine, all at Ta = 25 degC. The datasheet also specifies Pd = 0.2 W, Tstg = -55 to +125 degC, Tj = -55 to +150 degC, and typical RthetaJA = 500 degC/W on p. 1; these are limits or thermal data, not fitted DC points.

The supplied datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time, breakdown-voltage, or breakdown-current specification; VRRM and VDC are rating limits only. Fig. 3 capacitance and Fig. 4 power-derating plots were not included in the compact DC curve list; the tabulated CJ value is retained.
